name: HarmonicRotationEngine
description: This engine implements the harmonic-rotation oscillation of bodies, see also the `dynamics of harmonic motion <http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simple_harmonic_motion#Dynamics_of_simple_harmonic_motion>`__ ; please, set dynamic=False for bodies, droven by this engine, otherwise amplitude will be 2x...

attributes.name: fi
attributes.description: Initial phase [radians]. By default, the body oscillates around initial position.

attributes.name: rotateAroundZero
attributes.description: If True, bodies will not rotate around their centroids, but rather around ``zeroPoint``.

attributes.name: rotationAxis
attributes.description: Axis of rotation (direction); will be normalized automatically.

attributes.name: zeroPoint
attributes.description: Point around which bodies will rotate if ``rotateAroundZero`` is True
